gltf_axis_evidence: Source2Viewer GLB=(sourceY,sourceZ,sourceX)*.0254; verified on three independently dumped physics entities
limitations: AABB centers are geometric bounds centers, not artist pivots. Aggregate transforms are baked into indexed vertex positions.
Multiple source material draw calls can describe one prop. Do not instantiate each bounds record as a box.
Collision flags are retained; recommended vision treatment for grates/sky is a gameplay choice and does not duplicate all CS2 shader/penetration behavior.

baked_artifact_audit.intentional_visual_changes: Source alpha materials converted to coarse silhouettes, foliage QEM, removed minor surface stains/decals, non-render tools and verified atmospheric shader-effect sheets. Originally opaque prop, architecture, ground and canopy triangles retained.
